replies.author: @ToniHill-d1d
replies.text:
If you are posting this ignorant comment from the USA, then let me remind you that your ancestors were also immigrants. 

Educate yourself. Do you not know that Italians also immigrated to the USA? As all other nationalities of around the world? 

I am an American of color. I lived in the Friuli for years and return often. I lived in a beautiful town called Polcrnigo, a train ride from Venice. Close to Pordenone. And a few miles from beautiful Sacile, mentioned in the video. I worked at Aviano Air Force base. 

Living there was the highlight of my life. The people, unlike YOU were very kind. The country is stunning. I met wonderful people of many ethnicities. But we all had one thing in common. RESPECT. How DARE you vilify any group of people. People like you are the scourge of the earth.

comments.author: @Jean-PierreLoosli
comments.text: Comme souvent, la traduction française est catastrophique. Les noms de localités faux et souvent prononcés de manière différente. En plus la capitale du Frioul-Vénétie Julienne est Trieste et non Udine. Cette dernière n’est que le chef lieu du Frioul. Donc vérifiez vos traductions et prononciations.
